newsitem.title: FRANCE: JUDO-OLYMPIC CHAMPION DOUILLET INJURED IN MOTORCYCLE CRASH.
newsitem.headline: JUDO-OLYMPIC CHAMPION DOUILLET INJURED IN MOTORCYCLE CRASH.

text.p: Olympic judo heavyweight champion David Douillet of France has been injured in a motorcycle crash and will be out of action for five months.

The double world champion was in collision with a car as he was riding towards the French capital on Monday night. He had surgery on Tuesday and will remain in plaster for six weeks, the French judo federation said. Douillet, 27, suffered leg and shoulder injuries.
Douillet is the only man in judo history to have won both the world and Olympic heavyweight titles.
